snippet.title: CINDER CITY | Developer Interview
snippet.description:
Hear from Jae Hyun Bae, CEO of Big Fire Games & Executive Producer of CINDER CITY, on how DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation is helping him achieve the previously impossible, bringing his open-world MMO shooter to life.
